connector.name: Runcomfy MCP
connector.registryDescription: Remote MCP server for RunComfy Serverless API (ComfyUI): deployments and async inference.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.runcomfy.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the runcomfy-com account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: RunComfy API token as a Bearer credential (Bearer <YOUR_RUNCOMFY_TOKEN>). Get it from https://www.runcomfy.com/profile
